question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **"path".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct word **that we should put in the** blank (5) **is **"path"**.
 
• According to the meaning of the given sentence, **we must proceed** with the **utmost caution** with each step we take since the trail we leave in **our wake** is **just as significant as the one we walk.**
 
• So, **option 2)** is the **correct choice** for that **particular blank.**

**​Correct sentence: **Yet we must choose each step we take with utmost __caution, for the footprints we leave __behind__ are as important as the **__path__** we will follow.
